newsitem.title: USA: CME live and feeder cattle seen steady to easier.
newsitem.headline: CME live and feeder cattle seen steady to easier.

text.p: CME live and feeder cattle futures were expected to open steady to 0.100 cent lower, livestock analysts said.

Most analysts expect carryover pressure in live cattle futures following slow packer demand for fed cattle to start the week. Packers are seen holding bids down in the $61 to $62 per cwt area, they said.

However, some analysts look for support to develop as beef is starting to show underlying support. Also, small delivery notices are seen being posted against the February contract on first notice day, they said.

Feeder cattle futures were seen showing early carryover pressure following expected firmer corn futures which should add to technical weakness. Concern over increased movement from areas where pastures are dry may also weigh on prices. However, action in live cattle futures could give the market direction, analysts added.
The latest CME feeder cattle index was off $0.01 at $70.29 per cwt.
